messages:
ana: Heads-up — rolling out the 'onboarding circuit-breaker' micro-experiment tomorrow 10:00 PST. Goal: raise early DAU by ~6% via tighter credit + webinar nudge. Plan: 1) send 50 credits at signup (control: 100) 2) surface 3 prompt templates in product tour 3) enqueue webinar invite as an activation nudge at 48h. Need final copy + routing map by EOD.

mike: love it. what's the sample size? per-cohort?

ana: initial pilot 5k signups across web/mobile, split 50/50 random. test cells: full credits (100) vs circuit-breaker (50) + prompt templates vs no templates. powered by inbound-routing tag 'cb-pilot'.

sam: can we target by signup source? i.e., organic vs paid? analytics says paid has ~30% lower activation baseline.

ana: yes — we'll include source dimension. segment keys: organic, paid-search, referral.

jess: i can own the webhook and routing. i'll add a canary flag so we can rollback. config snippet:
```
route: cb-pilot
strategy:
  - 50% cohort_a (full_credits)
  - 50% cohort_b (circuit_breaker + templates)
rollback_if: "activation_rate_drop > 2%"
```

jess: setting up canary at 100 users first, then ramp.

natalie: sharing final webinar copy by 3pm. do we want a single webinar or weekly rolling? thought: two sessions first week to capture timezones.

ana: weekly rolling (Tue/Thu) for 2 weeks. landing page with CTA: "Build with Redwood — live demo + prompts". link to draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/webinar-draft

mike: for email cadence — sequence: immediate credit email (0h), product-tour nudge (6h), webinar invite (48h). add in-app banner at 6h too.

natalie: ok will do subject lines A/B: "50 free credits — get started" vs "Quickstart prompts + credits inside". i'll include both in initial test.

growth-bot: calendar: Webinar - Circuit Breaker Pilot created. attendees: #growth, #marketing. meeting link set.

sam: what metrics do we track? primary = activation (first 3 queries within 24h), secondary = 7-day retention, cost-per-activation.

ana: yep. I'll wire up the tracking events. analytics event names: `signup.credit_granted`, `onboarding.prompt_used`, `webinar.rsvp`.

jess: FYI infra wants the feature-flag name `cb_pilot_v1` and to watch for spike in KV cache on templates.

ana: thanks. last ask: can we get a quick QA pass before 9am tomorrow? @mike @jess @natalie

mike: can do.

jess: available.

natalie: yep.

ana: perfect. will post final copy in #marketing by 6pm. :thumbsup:
